name: Ganymede
tagline: The largest moon in the Solar System — bigger than Mercury, with its own magnetic field.
history: Ganymede is the only moon known to generate its own magnetic field — evidence of a convecting liquid-iron core wrapped in a deep internal ocean sandwiched between ice layers. Its surface splits into bright, grooved younger terrain and dark, heavily cratered ancient ground. Voyager and Galileo mapped it in detail; ESA's JUICE spacecraft, launched 2023, will enter orbit around Ganymede itself in 2031 — the first time any spacecraft circles a moon other than Earth's.
